title: Stair depth between the two limits, deck layout not stated
why: 275 mm passes only if the train is double deck, which the spec does not say.

spec.name: Stair depth between the two limits, deck layout not stated

stairs.step_depth_mm.required: ≥ 280 mm, or ≥ 270 mm if double deck
stairs.step_depth_mm.rationale: 4.2.2.8(1): 'maximum height of 200 mm and a minimum depth of 280 mm ... For double deck trains it is permitted to reduce this value to 270 mm': 275 fails 280 and meets 270; deck_layout is not supplied.
